# Vendored third-party files

Committed so that the site works offline (`--sample` demo), needs no CDN at run time
and a fresh clone needs only Python. Nothing here is edited by hand.

| File | Version | Source | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `echarts.common.min.js` | Apache ECharts 5.6.0 ("common" build: line, scatter, tooltip, legend, markLine, dataZoom) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.6.0/dist/echarts.common.min.js` | `55974cf42cc160e6cf9099cd3ed8cdedfaa9779919fcee7e2272c85f6ca30e27` |

Licence: Apache-2.0 (`echarts.LICENSE.txt`, `echarts.NOTICE.txt`).

Only `athlete.html` and `compare.html` load ECharts (664 KB, about 220 KB gzipped).

The stylesheet `../css/style.css` is generated by the Tailwind CSS standalone CLI
v3.4.17 (MIT) from `tailwind/input.css`; see `scripts/build_css.sh`.
